test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors.**

options.text: Anxiety is one of the most insidyous conditions affecting the mental health of an individual.
Anxiety is one of the most insidious conditions affecting the mental health of an individual.
Anxiety is one of the most insicdious conditions affecting the mental health of an individual.
Anxiety is one of the most insidiouos conditions affecting the mental health of an individual.

solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "Anxiety is one of the most insidious conditions affecting the mental health of an individual."
